item: Pinned Ollama for Linux x86_64 (the user's existing model runner; also used by q19 and q20)
why: L2-3 needs 'a pinned Ollama on localhost'. The fixture runs it on 127.0.0.1:11435 behind the logging proxy on Ollama's default 127.0.0.1:11434. One pin for q18, q19 and q20 keeps the local-model questions comparable.

candidates.source: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases (Linux amd64 archive of one tagged release)
candidates.size: about 1.5-2 GB archive (bundles GPU libraries; to confirm at pin time)
candidates.pin: the latest stable tag at freeze; put the exact asset URL and the SHA-256 from that release's checksum list in pins.env (OLLAMA_VERSION, OLLAMA_URL, OLLAMA_SHA256); setup_pinned_ollama.sh checks the hash after download

candidates.source: Docker Hub ollama/ollama:<version> (copy /usr/bin/ollama and /usr/lib/ollama into the dev image)
candidates.pin: pull by digest (ollama/ollama@sha256:...) and record the digest and `ollama --version`

candidates.size: same archive as the first candidate
candidates.pin: not recommended: the script itself is not pinned; if used, save the script's SHA-256 too

item: Frozen tool-calling fixture model (Ollama tag), shared with q19
why: L2-3 needs 'the frozen tool-calling fixture model (calibrated before freeze: 3 of 3 correct tool calls through Ollama's own API)'. It must run on 4 CPU cores within the 10-minute limit per run, and q19's coding agents send long prompts, so a 3-4B model is the practical size. calibrate_toolcall.py decides; pick the next candidate if one fails.

candidates.license: Llama 3.2 Community License (not OSI; allows use and redistribution under its terms)
candidates.pin: pull the tag, record the digest from GET /api/tags in pins.env (FIXTURE_MODEL_DIGEST), bake the model store into the base image; never pull again during eval
same as above. Stronger tool calling, but about 2x slower on CPU: check q19's prefill probe before choosing it
same as above. Thinks by default, which adds many tokens on CPU unless a client turns thinking off; calibrate with the default

item: dev image: the clean Linux environment for every L2 check (base image, packages, user)
why: Settled by 9.3 B (念誠, 2026-10-31): every Linux question but q03 and q10 uses the dev image (ubuntu:24.04 + python3, git, ca-certificates, curl, strace), built and recorded in eval/results/l2-images.json. Fixture infrastructure this question names (the pinned Ollama and model) is installed by the grader from eval/fixtures/PINS.md, not baked into the image.
proposal: Packages: python3, ca-certificates, curl, sudo, strace. User `dev` with passwordless sudo. q18 base image = dev image + pinned Ollama + fixture model store (built once with setup_pinned_ollama.sh).

item: strace in the dev image (the egress check)
why: Shared by every Linux question: listed once in eval/fixtures/_shared/needs.json (strace for _shared/egress.py).
